title: The quiet of Gros Morne
subtitle: Wide-open water. Weathered mountains. A little room to breathe.

cover.alt: Green mountains framing the water at Western Brook Pond in Gros Morne

chapters.title: Room to breathe
paragraphs: A different rhythm takes over when the frame fills with water and mountains. The eye follows a distant shoreline. The details get quieter. The landscape does the talking.
This is a sample layout for a Gros Morne photo essay. Replace these credited preview images and introductory words with your own photographs and field notes.

chapters.title: What stays with you
paragraphs: A collection does not have to include every photograph. A few carefully chosen frames can hold a whole day. Leave space for the landscapes, the small discoveries, and the feeling of being there.
